claims.statement: Customer-side capital commitment (Taiwan Union Technology material announcement, 2026-07-31): its Thailand and Zhongshan subsidiaries acquired one batch of operating machinery worth NT$4,152,384 thousand from Asia Metal Industries, an unrelated party, board-approved on 2026-07-29.
